answer: Agents resist Sybil by requiring each identity to post a unique, jury-graded reasoning artifact each epoch that embeds a public randomness beacon. The beacon forces the text to incorporate live words such as saffron lantern and shale; duplicates fail cryptographic shingle checks. An attacker must therefore generate and maintain distinct high-quality answers for every fake identity, costing continuous computational judgment equal to the number of Sybils times real agents, while honest ones pay only once.
